ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida) (64.8%), edible vegetable oil (palm, palmolein), sugar, liquid glucose, milk solids, butter (1.37%), salt, acidity regulator (330), raising agents [500(ii), 503(ii)], emulsifiers [450(i), 471], dough conditioner (223), dispersing agent (1520), flour treatment agent [1101(i)] and antioxidant (319). Contains added food colour (102) and added flavours (butter, cheese).
